steps.name: firebase_auth_check
steps.summary: Check that Google Application Default Credentials are usable.

Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_account (Optional[str]): Service account email, when applicable.
firebase_credential_is_user (bool): Whether publishes get a real author.
Returns: Success: If credentials resolve and can mint a token.
Error: If no ADC session exists or it cannot be refreshed.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_conditions
steps.summary: Show the template's conditions and choose which value a write targets.

Inputs (from ctx.data): condition (str, optional): Preselected condition name, or "default".
Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_condition (Optional[str]): Condition name, None for the default.
firebase_condition_label (str): User-facing label for the target.
Returns: Success: If a target is chosen (or only the default exists).
Error: If the template is missing or the user cancels.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_diff
steps.summary: Render the pending change and ask the user to confirm it.

Inputs (from ctx.data): firebase_target_label (Optional[str]): Display label for the project.
Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_change_confirmed (bool): Always True when the step succeeds.
Returns: Success: If the user confirms the change.
Exit: If the change is a no-op, or the user declines.
Error: If there is no pending change to show.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_fanout_plan
steps.summary: Build the per-project plan for one parameter change.

Inputs (from ctx.data): condition (str, optional): Condition to write instead of the default.
Returns: Success: If at least one project is selected for publishing.
Exit: If no project can take the change, or the user selects none.
Error: If inputs are missing.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_fanout_publish
steps.summary: Publish the planned change to each selected project.

Inputs (from ctx.data): dry_run (bool, optional): Validate everywhere, publish nothing.
Returns: Success: If at least one project published (or validated in a dry run).
Error: If the plan is missing or every project failed.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_get
steps.summary: Read the active Remote Config template for one project.

Inputs (from ctx.data): firebase_project_id (str): Project to read, from firebase_select_target.
project_id (str, optional): Alternative key for the same thing.
Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_remoteconfig_etag (Optional[str]): ETag needed to publish over it.
Returns: Success: If the template is read.
Error: If Firebase is unavailable, no project is given, or the read fails.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_publish
steps.summary: Publish one confirmed change, validating it with Firebase first.

Inputs (from ctx.data): dry_run (bool, optional): Validate only, publish nothing.
Returns: Success: If Firebase validated (dry run) or published the template.
Error: If inputs are missing, the change is unconfirmed, or the write fails.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_select_key
steps.summary: Choose one Remote Config parameter.

Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_value_type (str): Effective value type of the parameter.
firebase_current_value (Optional[str]): Raw current value, None if unset.
Returns: Success: If a parameter is selected.
Error: If the template is missing, the key is unknown, or the user cancels.

steps.name: firebase_remoteconfig_set_value
steps.summary: Ask for the new value of the selected parameter and validate it.

Inputs (from ctx.data): firebase_condition (Optional[str]): Condition to write, None for the default.
firebase_value_type (Optional[str]): Type reported by the read.
value (str, optional): New value, for non-interactive runs.
Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_new_value (str): Exact string that will be stored.
Returns: Success: If the value is valid for the parameter type.
Error: If inputs are missing, the value is invalid, or the user cancels.

steps.name: firebase_select_target
steps.summary: Resolve the Firebase project to work on.

Inputs (from ctx.data): project_id (str, optional): Firebase project ID to use.
project_label (str, optional): Friendlier name to show for it.
Outputs (saved to ctx.data): firebase_target_label (str): User-facing reference for the target.
Returns: Success: If a project could be resolved.
Error: If the plugin is unavailable or nothing names a project.

steps.name: firebase_select_targets
steps.summary: Resolve several Firebase projects from a caller-supplied list.

Inputs (from ctx.data): project_ids (list or str, optional): Projects to target; a comma- or space-separated string is accepted.
firebase_project_ids (list or str, optional): Same, as published by an earlier step.
firebase_project_labels (dict, optional): project_id to label, shown instead of the raw ID.
Returns: Success: If at least one project was named.
Error: If the plugin is unavailable or the list is empty.
